name: Tirzah
brief: Canaanite city that became the capital of Israel
short: Tirzah, a Canaanite city captured by Joshua, later served as the capital of the northern kingdom of Israel before Samaria (<ref="Josh. 12:24; 1Kgs. 14:17; 15:21, 33; 16:6-23">Josh. 12:24; 1Kgs. 14:17; 15:21, 33; 16:6-23</ref>).
